review_prompts: Can the reviewer, model, prompt, provider, or dispatch process be described as independent more strongly than the retained control evidence supports?
Can any corpus, digest, receipt, or result be changed, substituted, self-included, or detached from the exact target revision without rejection?
Does every finding distinguish observed evidence from inference and open author decision, with exact severity, impact, remediation, and residual risk?
Can secrets, private prompts, credentials, host paths, raw provider data, or personal data enter retained or publishable evidence?
Are COTS, budgets, PVF, no-deferral, rollback, typed synthesis, serialized integration, post-merge proof, and WP-20 release complete and fail-closed?
